text: Campers often use lanterns to light their way through dark trails at night. These lanterns offer a safe and reliable source of light, which is essential for safety and navigation. Lanterns are also a great addition to camping gear, as they can be used for storytelling, music, or even as a decorative feature. The trails themselves are a natural source of light, but the added light from the lanterns can make the experience even more enjoyable and peaceful.
